results.title: DronTech Asia 2026 Showcases the Technologies Shaping Asia's Fast-Growing Drone Industry
results.description: More than 150 exhibiting brands, live demonstrations and international conference sessions connect global technology providers with commercial and defense opportunities across Southeast Asia, 11-13 November in Thailand. BANGKOK, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Drones are rapidly becoming essential tools across agriculture, infrastructure, logistics, public safety and national defense. As artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, autonomous navigation and advanced communications transform unmanned systems, Asia-Pacific is emerging as an increasingly important market for the industry. The regional drone market is estimated to reach approximately US$30.2 billion in 2026 and is projected to grow to around US$62.4 billion by 2033, representing a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.9% from 2026 to 2033. Meanwhile, according to Next Move Strategy Consulting, Thailand's drone market was estimated at approximately US$262 million in 2025, equivalent to around THB 8.6 billion, reflecting expanding market opportunities driven by technological advancements and the increasing adoption of drones across various industries.* "Drone adoption is advancing more rapidly than many people realize, transforming industries ranging from defense and security to agriculture, logistics, infrastructure and disaster response. As these technologies become more capable and their applications continue to expand, it is increasingly important for businesses and governments to understand not only what drones can do today, but also the opportunities they will create in the future. DronTech Asia 2026 brings together leading technology providers, industry experts and stakeholders from across the region to explore these developments, experience the latest innovations and better understand the future capabilities of unmanned systems," said Mr. Manu Leopairote, Chairman of GML Exhibition (Thailand) Co., Ltd. Against this backdrop, DronTech Asia 2026 returns for its third edition from 11-13 November 2026 at IMPACT Exhibition & Convention Center Hall 5, Bangkok, Thailand. Recognized as Asia's fastest-growing exhibition dedicated to commercial and defense drone technology, the event brings together international technology providers, government agencies, defense organizations, system integrators and commercial users to explore the technologies and opportunities shaping the future of unmanned systems. The exhibition expects to welcome more than 5,000 international visitors and feature over 150 exhibiting brands and companies, alongside five indoor and outdoor demonstrations and more than 15 international conference sessions and technical seminars. Connecting Global Technologies with Southeast Asian Opportunities Across Southeast Asia, drones offer opportunities in precision agriculture, surveying and mapping, infrastructure inspection, disaster response, logistics and security. DronTech Asia provides a platform for regional buyers and end users to discover technologies, compare solutions, meet manufacturers and explore partnerships, while international companies can connect with stakeholders across Thailand and the wider ASEAN market. Featured exhibitors and technologies include: STM, showcasing the TOGAN reconnaissance and surveillance UAV, KARGU rotary-wing attack drone and KUZGUN long-range loitering munition.KNDS, presenting ammunition technologies, including short- and medium-range loitering munitions.DJI Enterprise by SIS, featuring the DJI Matrice 4E, a compact enterprise drone designed for surveying and mapping. Amazon Web Services (AWS), highlighting cloud platforms and software capabilities supporting drone operations, AI, geospatial analytics and secure data processing.STC (Special Technology Center), showcasing its LUN-20 UAV unmanned aerial system. Other participating companies include SYSTRONICS CO., LTD., AUTEL ROBOTICS CO., LTD., CHC NAVIGATION and ALCRONS FRONTIER CO., LTD. DronTech Asia 2026, Held 11-13 November in Thailand, Welcomes Over 150 Exhibiting Brands and Companies 15+ Sessions Covering the Drone Industry, Supported by AI-Powered Translation for Global Participants International Conferences Explore the Future of Unmanned Systems The international conference and technical presentation programs will examine developments across commercial and defense applications, offering insights into emerging technologies, operational requirements and regional opportunities. Highlighted sessions include: World Drone Congress (WDC) Bangkok Edition: "Low Altitude Economy, Soaring into the Future.""Thailand: Where ASEAN and the International Drone Ecosystem Converge," featuring contributions from DTI, CAAT, DEPA, private-sector companies and NECTEC."Next-Generation Military Unmanned Systems: Lessons, Requirements and Future Capabilities," presented by Thailand's Ministry of Defence and the Defence Technology Institute. Technical presentations will also examine cloud-powered drone operations and AI-enabled autonomy for defense and agriculture, presented by AWS, as well as anti-jamming and anti-spoofing technologies for mitigating GNSS vulnerabilities, presented by INFOX NAVIGATION TECHNOLOGY. Experience Drone Technology in Action Live indoor and outdoor demonstrations will give visitors the opportunity to see unmanned technologies in operation and understand their practical applications. Indoor demonstrations will feature ONCOMMAND, Disaster Response ID4 Association Thailand (D.R.A.T.), SYSTRONICS and 13 ENTERPRISE. Outdoor demonstrations presented by Thailand's Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa) will include disaster management and smart transportation and logistics applications. DronTech Asia 2026 to Hold Multiple Indoor and Outdoor Live Demonstrations Using Drones and Humanoids in Disaster Management, Logistics, and Transportation Register for DronTech Asia 2026 For professionals seeking new technologies, suppliers, business connections and insights into the evolving commercial and defense drone sectors, DronTech Asia 2026 offers an opportunity to engage with the international drone ecosystem in one place. International visitors will also enjoy courtesy Thailand MICE VISA prepaid credit cards which can be used for transportation, shopping, spa & wellness, and even food outlets at the venue. Visitors can discover new solutions, learn from technical experts, experience live demonstrations and connect with international technology providers across three days. Register in advance and join the industry in Bangkok this November. DronTech Asia 2026 Dates: 11-13 November 2026 Venue: Hall 5 IMPACT Exhibition & Convention Center, Bangkok, Thailand DronTech Asia is organized by GML Exhibition (Thailand) Co.,Ltd. results.title: Novelis Zhenjiang Named Airbus Quality Champion
results.description: Industry-leading quality and delivery performance recognized by Airbus; facility also achieves Aero Excellence Bronze status SHANGHAI, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Novelis Inc., a leading sustainable aluminum solutions provider and the world leader in aluminum rolling and recycling, today announced that its Zhenjiang plant in China received Airbus' Quality Champion award at the 2026 Airbus Supplier Conference in Toulouse, France. Novelis was the only materials company selected for the award among thousands of Airbus suppliers worldwide. The recognition highlights the Zhenjiang plant's consistently outstanding performance in quality and delivery. "Delivering the quality and reliability our aerospace customers expect requires consistency in how we operate every day," said Johan Petry, Vice President, Sales & Marketing, Global Aerospace, Novelis. "That's where the Novelis Operating System makes a difference, giving our teams a disciplined way to continuously improve how we work and serve our customers. Zhenjiang's recognition by Airbus demonstrates what that focus can achieve." Novelis' Zhenjiang plant also recently achieved Bronze status in the Aero Excellence Initiative. Supported by major aerospace OEMs, Aero Excellence is a global improvement and certification program that assesses industrial maturity and supply chain performance across the aerospace industry. Bronze status confirms that the Zhenjiang facility meets industry-recognized standards for operational excellence, environmental stewardship and secure digital infrastructure. Novelis' sister plant in Koblenz, Germany, also achieved Bronze status in February 2026, further demonstrating the company's commitment to continuous improvement across its global aerospace manufacturing network. Together, these recognitions reinforce Novelis' position as a trusted partner to the global aerospace industry. By combining world-class quality, operational excellence and sustainable manufacturing, Novelis continues to help aerospace customers meet the industry's most demanding performance standards while enabling a stronger and more resilient supply chain. About Novelis Novelis Inc. is driven by its purpose of shaping a sustainable world together. We are a global leader in the production of innovative aluminum products and solutions and the world's largest recycler of aluminum. Our ambition is to be the leading provider of low-carbon, sustainable aluminum solutions and to achieve a fully circular economy by partnering with our suppliers, as well as our customers in the aerospace, automotive, beverage can and specialties industries throughout North America, Europe, Asia and South America. Novelis had net sales of $18.4 billion in fiscal year 2026. Novelis is a subsidiary of Hindalco Industries Limited, an industry leader in aluminum and copper, and the metals flagship company of the Aditya Birla Group, a multinational conglomerate based in Mumbai. For more information, visit novelis.com.
